_metadata.source_title: Uniform Specification for Grade A & Common Rice — Kharif Marketing Season 2026-27
_metadata._notes: Values extracted from the current Government of India KMS 2026-27 specification. If the web source was unavailable during setup, these values should be verified against the official document.

broken.notes: Small broken (pieces below 1/4 of whole kernel length) shall not exceed 1% by weight

moisture.notes: Up to 15% may be procured with value cut under the cited specification. NOT measurable from image.

footnotes: Small broken pieces (below 1/4 of whole kernel length) shall not exceed 1% by weight.
Mineral matter shall not exceed 0.2% by weight.
Impurities of animal origin shall not exceed 0.10% by weight.
Moisture up to 15% may be procured with value cut under the cited specification.
All official limits are weight-based. Image-based analysis provides count/area estimates only.
Dehusked grain testing officially involves staining/chemical analysis — image-based analysis is a visual proxy.
Moisture requires physical/laboratory measurement and is outside the image-only pipeline.
The L/B ratio of 2.5 for Grade A/Common classification applies to paddy varieties, not milled rice.

image_assessment_mapping._description: Maps official parameters to image-assessable status

broken.limitation: Image provides count-based estimate, not weight-based

foreign_matter.limitation: Image provides count/area estimate, not weight percentage

dehusked.limitation: Visual bran-coverage proxy — not equivalent to official staining test

moisture.limitation: Requires physical/laboratory measurement — not measurable from RGB image
